caption: The drawing depicts a full-length figure of a female doll with a round face, dark brown hair parted in the middle and tied back with a headband, and distinct facial features including dark eyes, thin eyebrows, and a small mouth. The doll wears a pale pink and cream-colored dress with multiple layers and wide, ruffled sleeves. The dress features a pink sash around the waist, and the edges of the dress and sleeves have lace-like details. The doll's arms are covered with long, pink gloves, and she wears matching pink pantaloons that extend just above her ankles. Her feet are clad in grayish-blue slippers. To the lower left of the doll, there is a small rectangular sample labeled "mesh of lace enlarged 4 times." The background is an off-white or beige color, and the artist's name "Anna Colman" is written in the lower right corner.
title: Doll - "Martha Ann"
